title: Minimalist chrome — alignment, window buttons, selected state

steps.headline: The message box is centred again on Devil's Garden and Golden Sunbreak, lined up with the chips and status buttons.
steps.changed: Those two themes use the floating message-box style, whose own side margins were pushing the narrowed box to the left. The float style's centring now wins.
steps.notice: Opens on Golden Sunbreak. Every other theme looks the same as last round at the bottom.

steps.headline: Selected Files and the selected Chat segment are solid bright pills; minimize, maximize and close are three separate chips.
steps.changed: Built your pick from last round (solid bright pill). The window buttons lost their shared container; each has the same chip as every other header button. Close still turns red on hover.
steps.risk: The window buttons now look like any other header button, so the top-right corner reads as five buttons in a row.
steps.notice: Files is open in both pictures (top right); Chat is the selected half of the switch (top left). Check a light theme and a dark one.
